bucket_note: FNV-1a (32-bit, UTF-8 bytes) of the key, mod 65536, four hex digits as {hh}/{hh}.json.gz; the tree_details layout.
keys: tree numbers (canonical: upper case, no hyphen), akl_tree_* record IDs, v4 and v5 crown keys as published

notes.deleted_pointcloud_false_positive: removed in Sep 2026 before the 9 Sep release: the 2024 point cloud showed no tree at this LiDAR detection (roof, vessel, crane or water); no successor
notes.seeded_crown_retired: a crown drawn from a record in v5.2 that a reviewer moved to another crown; the successor is that record's tree
notes.v4_continues: v4 crown continuing as this crown (at least half of it lies in this crown and no other crown holds a fifth)
notes.v4_not_continued: v4 crown no current crown continues; the successor is the tree its representative record belongs to now
notes.v4_outside_v5: v4 crown outside the 2024 v5 survey, still drawn
notes.v4_split: v4 crown divided between several current crowns (each holds at least a fifth of it; largest share first)

number_format.check: Luhn mod 32 over the 6 characters after T
number_format.input: any case; spaces and hyphens ignored; I and L read as 1, O as 0

row_note: canonical = the tree number the key resolves to (null for a number itself, a split or a tombstone); detail = the tree_id whose full record shows that tree (null: the key itself); trailing nulls are omitted.

statuses.current: the key is the tree, its marker record or its crown
statuses.member: a record on the tree's crown without a marker of its own
statuses.merged: merged into the tree named by successor (a reviewer correction)
statuses.retired: no tree carries it now; successor names the tree that replaced it, if any; extra.p is the last known position
statuses.split: divided between the trees in successor (largest share first)

subset.note: Test fixture: a few rows of the published table, plus synthetic rows labelled below.
